record_title: Sharp logarithmic defect for a truncated double-Hilbert strip
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The result evaluates the specific truncated-strip family and its positive-dilation images; it is not a general stability theorem or an optimization over all finite-measure approximate eigenvectors. The source preprint is very recent, so unindexed contemporaneous observations remain a residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
